meta.title: Japan · Winter 2026/27
meta.tone: Un-hectic. Anime fans. May bring ski gear.

planningBanner.title: Route and village NYE are locked.
planningBanner.body: Still open: 8 vs 10, HND vs NRT, bring vs rent, Ghibli calendar, hotels.

group.skiGear: Some people may bring gear; others will rent. Who does which is still open.

constraints.text: City base is Tokyo only. No Osaka, Kyoto, Nagoya, or Ghibli Park.
Ski Nozawa ~5 proper days plus an arrival afternoon.
Tokyo: one hotel or apart-hotel, 5 doubles — not 3 Airbnbs.

statusLegend.label: Recommended
statusLegend.meaning: A suggested extra on a locked route. Not a booking.

statusLegend.label: Open / TBD
statusLegend.meaning: A fork, unpublished calendar, or decision the group still has to make.

statusLegend.label: Locked
statusLegend.meaning: A hard constraint, a closed window, or a confirmed fact we will not pretend is flexible.

stops.note: In 30 Dec, out 5 Jan · village NYE

days.title: Land, hotel, ship the ski bags
days.summary: Check in. Send ski bags and bulky luggage ahead with Yamato so the next Tokyo days stay light.

blocks.title: Hotel check-in
blocks.detail: One shared hotel or apart-hotel, 5 doubles. Area still open: Tokyo Station / Yaesu / Nihonbashi first, then Ueno, then Shinjuku.

blocks.title: Yamato Ski TA-Q-BIN from the hotel desk
blocks.detail: Hotel-desk Ski TA-Q-BIN is typically about ¥2,500–4,000 per piece. Aim the bags at the Nozawa front desk so they arrive before 30 Dec skiing. Round-trip cover is worth asking for.

days.title: Nakano Broadway + koshitsu izakaya
days.summary: Anime-fan day in Nakano, then a private-room izakaya so 8–10 people can actually hear each other.

blocks.title: Nakano Broadway
blocks.detail: Used-figure, doujin, and vintage floors. Un-hectic: pick one building and one coffee, not every shop.

blocks.title: Koshitsu izakaya dinner
blocks.detail: Book a private room (個室) for 8–10. Restaurant name TBD — do not invent one.

days.title: teamLab, then Donguri / Skytree or Shibuya
days.summary: One immersive museum, then a light neighbourhood. Not both museums.

blocks.title: teamLab Planets or Borderless — pick one
blocks.detail: Planets (Toyosu) is the water-walk museum, open through the end of 2027. Borderless is at Azabudai Hills. Timed tickets; buy ahead. Do not plan a van to Nozawa today.

blocks.title: Donguri Republic + Tokyo Skytree, or Shibuya
blocks.detail: Donguri is the official Ghibli shop (this is not Ghibli Park, and not museum tickets). Skytree is next door in Solamachi. Shibuya is the other fork if the group is tired of east Tokyo.

days.title: Hakutaka to Iiyama, then the village
days.summary: Travel day. Hakutaka only. Fit rentals and a first onsen. Full group skips Fukuoka.

blocks.title: Hokuriku Shinkansen Hakutaka, Tokyo or Ueno → Iiyama
blocks.detail: About 1h40. Typical fare about ¥8,300–8,900 depending on reserved vs unreserved and Tokyo vs Ueno. Kagayaki skips Iiyama — do not board it. No JR Pass for this trip. Book on JR-EAST Train Reservation (eki-net), not SmartEX.

blocks.title: Iiyama → Nozawa: jumbo taxi or Stay Nozawa van
blocks.detail: Nozawa Onsen Kotsu jumbo taxi (up to 9, luggage can drop that number): about ¥12,500 winter Iiyama–village. Stay Nozawa private van: ¥13,000 up to 8, 09:00–17:00. Do not plan a van on 29–31 Dec or 2–4 Jan. Liner bus is the fallback (adult ¥600, no reservation).

blocks.title: Onsen + rental fit
blocks.detail: Afternoon is for boots, not a full ski day. Thirteen free soto-yu in the village. Salomon Station adult ski-set day rate is ¥5,800 for 2026–27.

blocks.title: UVERworld Fukuoka — skip for the full group
blocks.detail: Concert is confirmed the same night in Fukuoka. Full group stays on this Tokyo→Nozawa day. Optional 1–2 people only. Same-night return is not realistic.

days.title: Ski 1 · village New Year’s Eve
days.summary: First proper ski day, then hotel dinner in the village. Village NYE is locked.

blocks.title: Ski day 1
blocks.detail: Adult day ticket ¥7,800 (2026–27 regular season). A 3-day consecutive ticket is ¥21,200.

blocks.title: Village NYE hotel dinner
blocks.detail: Eat where you sleep if the property does dinner; otherwise book early. Restaurant TBD.

blocks.title: Village NYE is locked
blocks.detail: Nozawa village NYE is locked. The Tokyo-through-2-Jan / train-3-Jan fork is not chosen.

days.title: Ski 2 · village shrine · hotel breakfast
days.summary: Second ski day. Hatsumode at a village shrine. Hotel breakfast if the lodging includes it.

blocks.title: Ski day 2
blocks.detail: Same mountain, un-hectic start after a late NYE.

blocks.title: Village shrine
blocks.detail: Hatcho / village shrine hatsumode. Exact shrine time TBD.

blocks.title: Hotel breakfast
blocks.detail: Depends on which lodging is booked. Lodging is still unbooked.

days.title: Ski 3 · Hikage
days.summary: Third proper ski day. Point the group at Hikage — gondola, kids park, gentler laps if anyone is tired.

blocks.title: Ski day 3 — Hikage side
blocks.detail: Hikage is the village-side base with gondola access. Trail map on the official portal.

days.title: Ski 4 or snow monkeys
days.summary: Fourth ski day, or the half-day monkey park. Do not DIY the monkeys.

blocks.title: Ski day 4 — default
blocks.detail: Keep skiing if weather is good.

blocks.title: Or: Nozawa Onsen Kotsu snow-monkey tour
blocks.detail: Do not DIY. Winter 2026–27 reservations open 1 Oct 2026. Adult ¥9,000. Check-in 12:30–13:00, depart 13:10, back about 17:00. Minimum 2 adults.

days.title: Ski 5 · drop Yamato bags
days.summary: Fifth proper ski day. Send bags back to the Tokyo hotel with 48–72 hours on the clock.

blocks.title: Ski day 5
blocks.detail: Last full recommended ski day on this skeleton.

blocks.title: Yamato bags toward Tokyo — 48–72h
blocks.detail: Drop at the lodging desk so bags are waiting at the Tokyo hotel before 8 Jan collection. Ski TA-Q-BIN wants the parcel at the destination the day before you need it.

days.title: Optional morning ski, midday train, buffer
days.summary: Leave Nozawa with a buffer. Tuesday is often a Ghibli closed day — do not assume a museum visit today.

blocks.title: Optional AM ski
blocks.detail: Only if legs and train time allow. This is extra, not one of the five proper days.

blocks.title: Midday Hakutaka Iiyama → Tokyo / Ueno
blocks.detail: Same rule: Hakutaka, not Kagayaki. Build slack for taxi / liner and ticket gates.

blocks.title: Ghibli is usually closed Tuesdays
blocks.detail: January 2027 operating days are unpublished. Last winter the museum was closed 27 Dec 2025–2 Jan 2026. Do not buy or claim tickets for today.

days.title: Primary Ghibli day — only if the calendar exists
days.summary: First-choice Ghibli Museum day if January 2027 is published and open. Otherwise Inokashira / Kichijoji / Donguri. Afternoon kimono and a mid-size shrine.

blocks.title: Ghibli Museum, Mitaka — IF the calendar says open
blocks.detail: January 2027 days are unpublished. Do not claim tickets exist. Lawson sale for January is 10 Dec 2026, 10:00 JST. Max 6 tickets per account. For 8–10 people you need two named purchasers, and both must attend. Adult timed ticket ¥1,000. This is Mitaka, not Ghibli Park.

blocks.title: Else: Inokashira, Kichijoji, Donguri
blocks.detail: Park walk, Kichijoji lunch, Donguri if anyone still wants merch. Calm backup.

blocks.title: Afternoon kimono + a mid-size shrine
blocks.detail: Shop and shrine names TBD. Keep it mid-size, not Meiji-jingu crowds if the group is tired.

days.title: Leftovers: Asakusa, Akihabara
days.summary: Whatever the group still wants — Senso-ji and the east-side streets, or Akihabara.

blocks.title: Asakusa
blocks.detail: Senso-ji and Nakamise. Un-hectic: go early or late.

blocks.title: Akihabara
blocks.detail: Radio-kaikan, hobby floors, one arcade. Not a full otaku marathon unless the group asks.

days.title: Buffer day · collect bags
days.summary: Nothing precious. Collect Yamato bags. Re-pack. Easy dinner near the hotel.

blocks.title: Collect forwarded bags
blocks.detail: Hotel desk. Confirm the waybill the night before.

blocks.title: Open buffer
blocks.detail: Neighbourhood leftover, laundry, or a long lunch. No new reservations that cannot slip.

days.title: Fly — HND or NRT
days.summary: Airport is still open. Build the transfer only after someone picks Haneda or Narita.

blocks.title: Depart HND or NRT
blocks.detail: Haneda vs Narita is an open decision. Do not lock a monorail or Skyliner plan until flights exist.

openDecisions.title: Village NYE is locked — Tokyo fork not chosen
openDecisions.detail: Nozawa village NYE is locked (arrive 30 Dec). The alternate stay-in-Tokyo through 2 Jan / train 3 Jan / ski 4–8 Jan is not chosen.

openDecisions.title: Fukuoka UVERworld — optional 1–2 people only
openDecisions.detail: Full group skips it. Optional 1–2 people only; overnight Fukuoka on the 30th. Same-night return is not realistic.

openDecisions.title: Lodging is unbooked
openDecisions.detail: Nothing is held. Tokyo MIMARU shortlist is live. Nozawa: Kashmir is available for 8 only.

openDecisions.title: Ghibli January 2027 days are unpublished
openDecisions.detail: Do not claim tickets exist. Last year closed 27 Dec 2025–2 Jan 2026. Lawson: 10 Dec 2026, 10:00 JST.

openDecisions.title: Headcount, airport, ski bags
openDecisions.detail: 8 vs 10 adults. Haneda vs Narita. Who brings skis vs who rents.

concert.groupRule: SKIP for the full group. Optional 1–2 people, light, overnight Fukuoka on the 30th.

tickets.fcLotteries: Fan-club NSW 1st and 2nd lotteries are closed.
tickets.creatorLifeSize: TAKUYA∞の創り方 and LIFEsize lotteries run through about 30 Aug 2026 (23:59).
tickets.generalSale: Fukuoka general sale is not posted. Do not invent a date.

concert.sameNightReturn: Same-night return Tokyo or Nozawa is not realistic.

ghibli.museum: Ghibli Museum, Mitaka — not Ghibli Park (Aichi).
ghibli.lastYearClosure: Closed 27 Dec 2025–2 Jan 2026. Next open day that year was 3 Jan 2026.
ghibli.tuesdayNote: Usually closed Tuesdays, plus extra winter maintenance. 5 Jan 2027 is a Tuesday.
ghibli.primaryDay: 6 Jan 2027 — only if the official calendar lists it as open.
ghibli.sale: Lawson Ticket, 10 Dec 2026, 10:00 JST, for January 2027 dates — if those dates are on sale.
rules: For 8–10 people, two named purchasers. Both must attend.
Named purchaser ID may be checked. Absent purchaser can mean refused entry.

tokyo.rule: Not booked. One MIMARU building can cover both Tokyo stays (in 27 Dec / out 30 Dec, and in 5 Jan / out 9 Jan). Prices are official member FROM for 1 apartment for the whole stay. Need 2–3 apartments. Hilton, Keio Plaza, Hyatt, and The Tokyo Station Hotel: no live 5-room calendar this pass. Hotel Granvia Tokyo does not exist (JR West brand).

candidates.name: MIMARU Tokyo Station East (recommended)
candidates.note: 2-bed inventory, courier desk 07:00–22:00, no breakfast. Not booked.

candidates.name: MIMARU Tokyo Shinjuku West
candidates.note: Most leftover. Last on the area rank. Not booked.

candidates.name: Hilton / Keio Plaza / Hyatt / The Tokyo Station Hotel

selfCatered.name: Kashmir House
selfCatered.note: AVAILABLE. 3 Double + 1 Cosy Double = 8 adults only. Breakfast, no dinner. Not vehicle-accessible (Yu-Road walk). About ¥1,102,100 for 4 rooms / 6 nights. Not booked.

selfCatered.name: Tamanegi House (Akari)
selfCatered.note: Enquire. Lodgify default ¥193,500/night (about ¥1,161,000 / 6 nights). A 7-night minimum may block this stay. Not booked.

selfCatered.name: Kamoshika
selfCatered.note: Sold out 24 Dec–9 Jan. Waitlist. Also ask Bonbori and Tanuki in the same email. Not booked.

halfBoard.name: Tokiwaya
halfBoard.note: 30 Dec open; 31 Dec and 1 Jan 満室. Cannot book a 6-night block online. Not booked.

halfBoard.name: Kiriya
halfBoard.note: No online NYE plans. Not booked.

halfBoard.name: Shimataya
halfBoard.note: No public calendar. Ask for 5 rooms half-board. Also res@nozawahospitality.com. Not booked.

closed.name: Stay Nozawa RoomBoss block
closed.note: Kamoshika, Bonbori, Tanuki 4BR, Iroha, Dennojo, and MARU SUMI are blocked 24 Dec–6 Jan on RoomBoss. No instant-bookable whole house.

closed.name: Nozawa Holidays chalets
closed.note: Slopeside, Central 301, Villa, and Lodge Nagano sold out on Bookings247. 7-night minimum on the chalets anyway.

yamato.text: Yamato Ski TA-Q-BIN from a hotel desk is typically about ¥2,500–4,000 per piece. Convenience-store drop-off is not available for Ski TA-Q-BIN. Ship so the bag is at the resort the day before you ski.

train.text: Hakutaka only. Kagayaki skips Iiyama. Tokyo or Ueno → Iiyama about 1h40, about ¥8,300–8,900. No Japan Rail Pass for this itinerary (Tokyo–Iiyama return does not earn one). Book JR-EAST Train Reservation, not SmartEX.

transfer.text: Jumbo taxi about ¥12,500 for up to 9, or Stay Nozawa van ¥13,000 for up to 8. Do not plan a van on 29–31 Dec or 2–4 Jan. Liner bus adult ¥600 if the private options are gone.

tickets.season: 2026–27 regular season (19 Dec 2026–28 Mar 2027 on the official table)

onsen.sotoYu: 13 free village soto-yu, run by Yunakama neighbourhoods. Bring your own towel and soap.

checklist.title: Route is locked
checklist.detail: Tokyo 27–29 Dec (in 27, out 30) → Nozawa 30 Dec–4 Jan (in 30 Dec, out 5 Jan) → Tokyo 5–8 Jan (in 5, out 9) → fly 9 Jan.

checklist.title: Lock 8 vs 10 adults
checklist.detail: Room math, van vs two taxis, and Ghibli purchaser count all hang on this.

checklist.title: Choose HND or NRT
checklist.detail: Do not build a last-day transfer until flights exist.

checklist.title: Book Tokyo stay
checklist.detail: Not booked. One MIMARU can cover both stays. Need 2–3 apartments.

checklist.title: Book Nozawa stay
checklist.detail: Not booked. No instant-bookable whole house. Kashmir is available for 8 only.

checklist.title: Village NYE is locked
checklist.detail: Nozawa village NYE is locked. The Tokyo-through-2-Jan fork is not chosen.

checklist.title: Who brings skis vs who rents
checklist.detail: Changes Yamato volume and Salomon Station reservations.

checklist.title: Optional: 1–2 people UVERworld Fukuoka
checklist.detail: Creator / LIFEsize through ~30 Aug 2026. FC lotteries closed. Fukuoka general sale not posted. Overnight 30 Dec if anyone goes.

checklist.title: Reserve Hakutaka seats both ways
checklist.detail: Not Kagayaki. Not a JR Pass. JR-EAST Train Reservation.

checklist.title: Book Iiyama ↔ Nozawa transfer
checklist.detail: Jumbo taxi or Stay Nozawa van. No van 29–31 Dec or 2–4 Jan.

checklist.title: Plan Yamato Ski TA-Q-BIN both ways
checklist.detail: Desk drop 27 Dec outbound; 4 Jan return with 48–72h.

checklist.title: Watch the Ghibli calendar — do not buy yet
checklist.detail: January 2027 unpublished. If dates appear, Lawson 10 Dec 2026 10:00 JST. Two named purchasers for 8–10.

checklist.title: Buy one teamLab timed entry
checklist.detail: Planets or Borderless, not both, for 29 Dec.

checklist.title: If monkeys: book Kotsu from 1 Oct 2026
